caption: The drawing depicts a square clock face with a beige or light tan background and a subtle crackle texture. The clock face is circular within the square, and large, stylized black numerals from 1 to 12 encircle its perimeter. The hour and minute hands are ornate and black, with the minute hand pointing just past the 12 and the hour hand on the 11. The corners of the square feature decorative floral designs in red, pink, blue, and yellow, with accompanying green leaves on a beige background. The inner area of the clock face, surrounding the central pivot point for the hands, also contains smaller floral patterns in blue, pink, yellow, and white with green leaves. There are decorative gold rings forming the boundary of the square and the circular dial, and there are small black markers within the gold circles at regular intervals. The overall color palette includes shades of beige, black, green, red, blue, yellow, and pink.
title: Clock Face
